correctness.rationale: Explicit disjoint-arc probability gives six independent rate-1/P endpoint Poisson gaps. First-order distance derivatives at AB and AC give apex min(X,aY) and min(Y,aX), independent base minima each rate β=1/c, plus deterministic λ shift. CDF conditional expectation and quadratic onset follow by exact integration over V≤h. Correlation follows by integration on three ratio cones. Finite-N sampling checks and algebra run successfully, but are not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: A natural N^-1 competition of the two nearly diametral polygon sides has a new explicit correlated Poisson crossover and detectable exact curvature singularity. It identifies a sharp geometric phase split, and the zero-gap onset doubles a natural lower-tail coefficient. This is significant beyond routine fixed-shape sample extreme-value algebra; no paper-sized downstream consequence is claimed.
